frequency_question: How often do Union ministries successfully file compliance or final notification within court-ordered deadlines on contested health regulations?
membership_rule: Includes all instances where India's Supreme Court set a hard deadline for a Union ministry to finalize or report on contested food/health safety regulations. Excludes general policy consultations without court mandates.

coverage_note: 5 named relevant cases; representative of high-friction regulatory compliance under judicial monitoring in India.
known_gaps: Excludes minor state-level compliance orders; focuses strictly on Union government mandates.
skeleton: Total court-mandated administrative deadlines tracked across environmental and public health sectors, categorized by whether extension requests or compliance notices were filed on time.
multiplier: 2 hits out of 5 named baseline cases = 40% base rate
validity_reason: Judicial oversight strictness and bureaucratic responsiveness timescales remain relatively stable over multi-year administrative cycles.
